text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, whew, pheeew... A parade... 
wasn't graceful in the slightest~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san is fast, strong... And that 
hill...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The turf felt so much heavier than Kyoto 
usually does... The pressure made my legs 
freeze up...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So this is a Long-distance GⅠ... This is 
the Spring Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Doto. You did decently as the 
pacesetter.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you are to run by my side, never 
forget: this whole year will be a long and 
arduous path, just like today.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee, next time... I'll work so much 
hardeeer!

I vow to grow even further. As expected, 
keeping up with T.M. Opera O is going to 
be no ordinary feat...
